admin_home_alpha_desc: Live account: the agent proposes, you decide.
admin_home_beta_desc: Paper-trading replica of the same method.
admin_layout_description: Vennett rooms: Alpha, Beta, and Omega
admin_error_message: There was a problem displaying this screen.
admin_generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin_liga_daily_note: 5:15 p.m. New York time on trading days: prices for portfolio holdings and SPY.
admin_liga_create_seasons_note: Create the preseason (through December, not scored) and season 1 (January–December 2027), with its rounds.
admin_liga_preview_unwritten: Preview only: nothing has been written yet.
admin_liga_missing_close: The last trading day close is missing for {tickers}. This is usually a temporary data-source issue; retry first. If the stocks are not trading (suspended or delisted), check this to close using their last known close.
admin_liga_last_attempts: Most recent attempt for each process
admin_settings_confirm_ai: This will start spending real money on AI calls. Turn it on?
admin_setting_registration_help: Allow new people to register for the league. When off, no new users can register; existing users can keep playing.
admin_setting_league_public_help: Show the league to people who are not signed in. When off, users must sign in to view it.
admin_setting_ai_converter_help: Allow a natural-language prompt to be converted into strategy rules with AI. When off, this conversion is unavailable.
admin_setting_ai_question_help: Allow questions about a company through Jev during a test. When off, this feature is unavailable.
admin_setting_ai_reading_help: Generate text explaining a strategy’s results. When off, no explanation is generated.
admin_setting_ai_cap_help: If actual user AI spending (converter, tests and readings) reaches this amount during the month, those calls stop until the next month. Leave blank for no cap.
admin_setting_ai_formation_title: Own question when forming the round
admin_setting_ai_formation_help: Let the system answer each strategy's own question with AI (Jev) when forming the round. When off, those strategies play without their question.
admin_setting_ai_formation_cap_title: Monthly spending cap when forming the round
admin_setting_ai_formation_cap_help: If this month's spending on formation questions reaches this amount, those strategies play without their question until next month. Separate from the user cap. Leave blank for no cap.
admin_setting_form_question_limit_title: Maximum time for questions when forming
admin_setting_form_question_limit_help: Seconds the formation waits for the AI to answer own questions. When it runs out, strategies missing any answer play without their question.
admin_settings_spending_formation_lead: When forming the round you have spent
admin_setting_ai_margin_help: How many times above actual cost a purpose must be to count as profitable in the cost panel. This only changes the panel color; it does not turn anything off.
admin_setting_welcome_credits_help: One-time credits given to each new account when it is created. Applies only to future accounts; set to 0 to disable.
admin_setting_auto_photo_help: After the monthly decision scan finishes, automatically choose the photo and scan for the next round that does not have a photo. When off, use the manual button.
admin_setting_auto_form_help: Every 5 minutes, check whether a round can be formed (after its cutoff at 9:00 a.m. New York time on the first trading day, with its photo and scan selected), then form it. This is the normal flow. When off (emergency mode), only an admin can use the button.
admin_cost_breakdown_help: For information only: it does not change the totals, the margin or the cap.

admin_moderation_confirm_question: the strategy tied to this question
admin_moderation_confirm_hide: Hide {item}? This will resolve the report.
admin_moderation_count: There are {total} reports; showing the {shown} oldest.
admin_moderation_missing: (no longer exists or cannot be read)
admin_users_created_notice: Account created. Share these details; the temporary password will not be shown again.
admin_users_alias_invalid: That name was unavailable (invalid format, reserved, or already taken), so the account will use “{alias}”. The user can change it in Your account.
admin_users_change_password: Ask the user to change the password in Your account after signing in.
admin_user_confirm_pro_no_end: Grant Pro with no end date?
admin_user_amount_positive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
